headline: Josh Johnson Muses on the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool
context: “Hey, kids, remember you wanted to go to Disneyland? Instead, we’re going to go see the world’s largest kombucha!” Johnson said of the pool renovation as a tourist stop.
